title: backrest config
description: Configuration for the backrest unified backup runner.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema used for validation/autocomplete. Do not remove.

log_dir.description: Directory where backup run logs are written. Supports $HOME and environment variables.

log_retention_days.description: Delete backup-*.log files older than this many days.

paths.description: Named path placeholders. Values are substituted for ${name} references anywhere in the config (e.g. "storage": "/mnt/drive" makes ${storage}/restic/x valid).

restic_password_file.description: Path to a file containing the restic repository password.

restic_password_command.description: Command that prints the restic password to stdout. Alternative to restic_password_file.

restic_password_autogen.description: When true and no password_file/command is set, generate a random restic password on first run and save it to ~/.config/backrest/restic-password. Reused on subsequent runs.

check.description:
Default integrity check mode for restic profiles.
- full: restic check --read-data (reads whole repo, slow)
- quick: restic check (metadata only, fast)
- never: skip integrity check

healthchecks_url.description: Healthchecks.io check URL. Pings <url>/start on start, <url> on success, <url>/fail on failure. Empty disables.

profiles.description: Backup jobs. Each key is a profile name (run one via ./backrest <name>).

enabled.description: When false, the profile is skipped on 'run all' but can still be run explicitly (./backrest <name>). Defaults to true.

type.description:
Backend:
- restic: incremental deduped snapshots to a restic repo
- rsync: mirror copy to a local dest (and optionally remote_dest)
- s3: rclone sync to a cloud bucket (e.g. myremote:bucket/path)
- sqlite: versioned sqlite3 snapshots of a database to a dest dir

src.description: Source path to back up. Supports ${path} placeholders. May be a host:path (remote) reference.

repo.description: (restic/sqlite only) Path to the restic repository. Created/initialized automatically on first run. For sqlite, the consistent snapshot is stored here.

dest.description: (rsync/s3 only) Local destination directory for rsync, or rclone remote path (e.g. myremote:bucket/path) for s3.

remote_dest.description: (rsync only) Optional second rsync destination, e.g. user@host:/path for off-site copies.

retention.description: (restic/sqlite only) restic forget policy string, e.g. "keep-daily 7 keep-weekly 4". Defaults to "keep-last 10".

exclude.description: (restic only) rsync/restic --exclude patterns. Skips matching files/dirs.

flags.description: (s3 only) Extra rclone flags passed to the sync, e.g. ["--checksum"] to compare by checksum instead of size+mtime (fixes needless re-uploads on cloud-to-cloud sync).

prehook.description: Executable script run before the backup (e.g. database dump, stop container). Must be executable.

posthook.description: Executable script run after the backup, even on failure (e.g. restart container). Must be executable.

check.description: Integrity check mode, overrides global.check. See global.check.
